with src.open() as f:
    r=csv.reader(f)
    header=next(r)
    assert header==['geneID','KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3'], header
    # create writers
    files={s: outdir/(s+'.tsv') for s in header[1:]}
    writers={s: open(p,'w',newline='') for s,p in files.items()}
    for s,w in writers.items():
        w.write(f'geneID\\t{s}\\n')
    for row in r:
        gid=row[0]
        for j,s in enumerate(header[1:], start=1):
            writers[s].write(f'{gid}\\t{row[j]}\\n')
    for w in writers.values():
        w.close()
for p in sorted(outdir.iterdir()):
    print(p.name, p.stat().st_size)
    print(p.read_text().splitlines()[:2])
